task.question: How many people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026?
task.evidence: August 15 – At least 129 people are killed and nearly 1,300 injured when a magnitude 7.7 earthquake strikes off the island of Flores, Indonesia.

answer: FINAL: According to the National Agency for Disaster Countermeasure (BNPB), at least 136 people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026.
final: According to the National Agency for Disaster Countermeasure (BNPB), at least 136 people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026.

According to the National Agency for Disaster Countermeasure (BNPB), at least 136 people were killed and 1,776 others were injured, [ 36 ] [ 37 ] 336 of them seriously. [ 38 ] It is the deadliest earthquake in Indonesia since the 2022 West Java earthquake . [ 39 ] East Nusa Tenggara governor Emanuel Melkiades Laka Lena said most of the victims died while they were asleep as rubble fell onto them. [ 40 ] Manggarai and East Manggarai regencies recorded 41 and 36 deaths, respectively; 13 deaths were reported in Nagekeo, and the remaining 15 deaths were from Sikka, Ende, Ngada and West Manggarai.
